name: quantum-tradeworks
description: Quantum Tradeworks — Malaysia-first cross-asset research prototype for US and Bursa equities and Malaysian property. Research only. 119 US companies carry audited statements from SEC filings; the 18 Malaysian companies and one US company (PGR) are illustrative and synthetic; no market data is included. The deployed site is static files with no runtime dependencies — a self-contained index.html, and small per-route pages that load its script and stylesheet once from assets/ — assembled from src/ by build.mjs and committed, so the host still serves them with no build step.
